channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Friday’s open watchlist item closed after the close bell, and Monday’s rental tape is flat. CleanSpark’s wholly owned subsidiary CSDC Finance I, LLC closed its previously priced $2.276 billion of 7.875% senior secured notes due 2031 on 25 Sep (Form 8-K Items 1.01/2.03, accession 0001193125-26-402944; IR close release same day). Issue price 98.500%; net proceeds are earmarked to finish the Sandersville, Georgia data center, reimburse prior equity contributions, and fund debt-service reserves — with a CleanSpark completion guarantee. That converts Friday’s priced-not-closed watch into a closed project-finance print for the already-wired Meta/Anviran 175 MW Sandersville campus (Signal update, not a new Wire id). Same-venue Silicon Tape re-read this morning: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW across Lambda / CoreWeave / Crusoe / DigitalOcean / GCP TPU / AWS Capacity Blocks. Lambda on-demand anchors hold at H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DigitalOcean B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X spot $2.46 / MI355X spot $2.97 all confirm vs Friday. Applied Digital’s Brookwood / Delta Forge 2 campus remains on a ~1 Oct construction start with tenant still unnamed; PUCT 58481 still Interchange 218/219 (effective 10.08.2026); TCEQ Abbott update still due 19 Oct; Fermi×TensorWave Matador still due 31 Oct.
